selection_rule: >=20 positive weeks in first 72 calendar weeks; normalized StockCode; excluded known service/fee/adjustment codes
notes: All product segments use first 72 calendar weeks only.
ADI/CV2 uses the standard four-pattern demand classification; threshold ADI=1.32, CV2=0.49.
High concentration is a descriptive top-decile flag on maximum weekly share, not proof of wholesale orders.
Sales target is recorded positive units, not latent demand or lost sales.
Test-set segment metrics are diagnostic only; use validation or future rolling-origin backtests for model selection.
